members.note: creative skip and the break path; the bow's destroyCurrentEquippedItem tail is throw.c:consume_arrow. The player's other paths: survival.c surv_damage_stack (server: the hoe, the flint and steel, the shears on sheep and mooshrooms, the flint on creepers and TNT, armour, combat) and client_damage_stack (the client's copy: the Unbreaking rolls on its Random, renderBrokenItemStack's draws; the break stat is not independent, so the client drops it). A stack the dig machine breaks counts its useItem and breakItem under the item it broke as (survival.c surv_dig_adopt_stats, held_was).

notes: The port represents a stack as a plain struct (item, count, damage, tag); the field-backed accessors are marked exact with a null native for that reason. enchant.c:item_enchantability and the enchanting paths are gated off by world.conf enchanting = off. Verification only (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): verification only: the member is ported but no scene pins it; covered by the verify list, not a port (the full-stack equality detectAndSendChanges uses; screens-* recordings exercise it). It stays partial until a recording pins it. Tags (lane/itemtags): one interned tag store (itemtag.c) carried by every stack struct, the inventory, containers, crafting, trades, drops, pickups, spills, frames, packets and snapshot loads; item-tags-s1 pins them. lane/idxblocks: every member exact; the bowl and bottle returns were already ported. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was in_scope/exact: a reachable behaviour is not native (missing). lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: the tooltip half was stale since lane/idxclient d4352f71 (idx-tip*-s1); animationsToGo, the hotbar's pickup pop, was a real gap (the golden's squashed dirt at cr-pickup-s1 81), ported.
